current_milestone.title: Expressive Capability
current_milestone.active_objective: Use the fingerprinted editable current MA2 Test Show for SHEESH_CURRENT_SHOW_REDESIGN_001: snapshot the real Show, let ZEN design Stage/3D spatial geometry upstream of SHEESH lighting design, and write back only through verified supported Test-Show paths.

last_closed_task.result: TEST_SHOW_MODE real-console build verified: 13 owned Color presets, provisional TEST_STAGE_LAYOUT_SHEESH_001, Sequence 901 with 15 Cues, and Page 1 Executor 201 / ZEN_SHEESH_TEST. No Timecode was written because no actual audio file was available.

next_acceptance_gate.why_it_matters: Zen explicitly authorized the currently loaded fingerprinted Test Show for a bounded redesign experiment. The high-value evidence is now whether ZEN can read the real rig, create its own spatial design before song design, and safely realize supported portions without coding-agent artistic intervention.
next_acceptance_gate.next_review_condition: Complete the current-Show snapshot and ZEN spatial/SHEESH run; write only supported safe portions; report any spatial/autonomous write capability gap instead of inventing raw MA commands.

human_review_decisions.limitations: Authorization is limited to the fingerprinted current Test Show, this SHEESH/Stage View experiment and Agent-owned objects. It does not authorize Patch, Address, Fixture ID, Fixture Type, Fixture 9999, unrelated objects or production Show writes.
No numeric-ID tie-break, equal Group level, cohort saturation, Group participation count, or dimmer level may be promoted into Lighting Design knowledge or a production strategy.

evidence_results.limitations: This explicit Test Show authorization closes the resource absence blocker for SHEESH only. It does not establish a permanent palette, Group-to-Color role, B3 production authorization, or a Color design rule.
Fixture COLOR capability and generic typed CALL_PRESET syntax do not establish a current Show Color preset, applicability, palette, role, or B3 authorization.
